description: REQ-D2 requires an evidence dict containing `slot_age_days` and `time_horizon_days`, and REQ-L2/L3 require the pure helper to take `slot_age_days: float` and `time_horizon_days: int`. Neither the behavioral spec nor the verification architecture defines HOW the dispatcher computes `slot_age_days` (source of truth: slot_dir mtime? menu.json created_at? earliest roi.jsonl row?) or WHERE it reads `time_horizon_days` (menu.json via `resolve_time_horizon_days()` per sprint-3 #34 REQ-T1?). Both are load-bearing for the dormant judgment. Without prescriptions, two implementations can pass the unit tests yet disagree on production behavior — for example, `slot_dir` mtime is bumped whenever `_write_status` writes core-status.json each tick (line 47-49), so slot_age would effectively reset every tick if that is the chosen source. Spec must specify both.

evidence.snippet: REQ-D1..D2 — no definition of slot_age_days source or time_horizon_days lookup
